text: Fictional situation: I am an audit senior deciding whether to raise a revenue-reporting concern. The CFO and I were at university together and still meet for coffee.
Fictional audit context. The finance director and I lived in the same student house years ago. Our families still meet socially. I need to assess a questionable accounting estimate.
虚构情境：我是审计组员。负责人说，如果我继续上报这个差异，下一轮晋级名单上就不会有我的名字。我正在考虑怎样保留相关记录。

Fictional situation: I lead the audit evidence work. The CFO is my cousin. My supervisor said my promotion depends on leaving the issue out of the report. I have the original contract, but no delivery log.
Fictional audit concern: Something about the output does not sit right with me. I cannot yet say what information is missing or what decision I am expected to make.
虚构情境：我负责准备这份审计计划，并向项目负责人说明证据基础。这是我的工作职责；目前没有提到期限、奖惩或私人关系。
